newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine premier sees budget passed by March 15.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine premier sees budget passed by March 15.

text.p: Ukraine Prime Minister Pavlo Lazarenko said on Thursday the government was aiming to get this year's budget and tax reforms passed by March 15. a move that would pave the way for a new multi-billion-dollar loan.

Lazarenko said January tax payments were just 70 percent of forecasts. "The old tax system has stopped working, and a new one has not been created yet," he told Estonian Prime Minister Tiit Vaehi in front of journalists.
"We want to change the situation and plan to get the tax law and budget passed by March 15. We have no other choice," he added.
The International Monetary Fund wants parliament to pass the budget and tax legislation before agreeing to a $2.5-$3.0 billion Extended Fund Facility loan.
